newsHighlights.title: Buckwheat noodles carry living Long March memories
newsHighlights.summary: A veteran in Wuqi county treated visiting college students from Beijing to local lamb chopped buckwheat noodles while sharing living memories of the Long March.
newsHighlights.translation: 在陕西吴起县，一位老兵请来此实践的北京大学生品尝当地羊肉剁荞面，并向他们讲述了仍然鲜活的长征记忆。

newsHighlights.title: Nation mourns death of singer, mentor Liu Huan
newsHighlights.summary: China mourns singer and mentor Liu Huan, remembered not only for his music but for guiding a generation of young performers.
newsHighlights.translation: 全国悼念歌手、导师刘欢，人们铭记的不仅是他的音乐，还有他对一代青年歌手的引领与培养。

newsHighlights.title: China's northernmost high-speed rail starts service
newsHighlights.summary: China's northernmost high-speed railway, running through a region of discontinuous permafrost in Heilongjiang, officially entered service on Monday.
newsHighlights.translation: 穿越黑龙江多年冻土区的中国最北高铁于周日正式开通运营。

newsHighlights.title: Hi Five China: Huaihua's bamboo breakthrough
newsHighlights.summary: In Huaihua, a mountain city in Central China, bamboo is turned into keyboards, mice and even truck bed panels through technological innovation.
newsHighlights.translation: 在湖南怀化这座山城，通过技术创新，竹子被制成键盘、鼠标，甚至卡车车厢板。

newsHighlights.title: Chinese tech firms target walking-assist wearables
newsHighlights.summary: Chinese technology companies are developing walking-assist wearables designed to help the elderly and people with limited mobility.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国科技企业正研发助行可穿戴设备，帮助老年人和行动不便者重新行走。

quote.quote: Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn.
quote.author: Benjamin Franklin
quote.translation: 告诉我，我会忘记；教导我，我会记住；让我参与，我才能真正学会。
quote.explanation: 这句名言强调学习的最高层次是亲身体验与参与。正如新闻中的大学生走进吴起县、听老兵讲述长征故事，实地参与远比死记课本更能让知识内化为成长的力量。

vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻 "Buckwheat noodles carry living Long March memories"，学生此行的核心意义是纪念与学习。

vocabulary.translation: 鲜活的长征记忆是国家文化遗产的一部分。

vocabulary.example: For the students, listening to a veteran was a hands-on history lesson far better than any textbook.
vocabulary.translation: 对学生们来说，听老兵讲述是一堂亲身实践的历史课，胜过任何教科书。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻 "Buckwheat noodles carry living Long March memories"，强调实践式、体验式学习。

pattern.pattern: I came for ..., but I stayed for ... （我为……而来，却为……而留下）
pattern.example: Came for the noodles. Stayed for the history.
pattern.translation: 为荞麦面而来，为这段历史而留下。
pattern.usage: 该句型来自新闻原文，使用了省略主语的祈使式/口语化表达。完整形式为 "We came for the noodles, but we stayed for the history."，用来表达：最初被表层事物吸引，最终被更深层的价值打动。适用于游记、观后感、人物描写等场景，如：I came for the course, but I stayed for the people.

grammar.title: 现在分词作后置定语与伴随状语
grammar.explanation: 现在分词（doing）放在名词后作后置定语，相当于 who/which/that 引导的定语从句；放在句中作状语，表示伴随、补充说明或方式，逻辑主语必须与句子主语一致。新闻标题和正文中大量使用这一结构，使句子简洁生动。
examples: China's northernmost high-speed railway, running through a region of discontinuous permafrost in Northeast China's Heilongjiang province, officially entered service on Monday.
A group of visiting college students from Beijing were treated to local lamb chopped buckwheat noodles by a veteran sharing his memories of the Long March.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第一个音节 /ˈbreɪk/。关键难点在 /kθr/ 三个辅音相连：先发 /k/，舌尖轻触上齿发清辅音 /θ/（不可读成 /s/ 或 /f/），再快速滑向 /r/。元音 /eɪ/ 为双元音，口型由开到合。可先慢读 "break - through"，再连读成 "breakthrough"。
examples: Huaihua's bamboo breakthrough has drawn attention from manufacturers around the world.
Engineers achieved a major breakthrough in building railways on permafrost.

reading.title: More Than a Bowl of Noodles: Learning History Where It Happened
reading.content:
Last week, a group of college students from Beijing travelled to Wuqi county in Shaanxi province. They came for the local lamb chopped buckwheat noodles, but they stayed for the history. Over the meal, a veteran told them stories of the Long March, turning a simple lunch into a hands-on lesson.

For the students, the trip was more moving than any textbook. Standing where the Red Army once arrived, they felt what words on a page could not convey. "We came for the noodles, and we stayed for the history," one student said.

Educators say such visits are a powerful form of experiential learning. When history is told by those who carry its living memories, young people are more likely to remember it and pass it on. As the nation mourns the loss of teachers and mentors like singer Liu Huan, the value of good guidance has never felt more real.
reading.translation:
上周，一群北京的大学生来到陕西省吴起县。他们为当地的羊肉剁荞面而来，却为这段历史而留下。吃饭时，一位老兵给他们讲述了长征的故事，把一顿简单的午饭变成了一堂生动的实践课。

对学生们来说，这趟旅程比任何教科书都更打动人心。站在红军当年到达的地方，他们感受到了书本上的文字无法传达的东西。一名学生说：“我们为荞麦面而来，为这段历史而留下。”

教育工作者认为，这样的走访是体验式学习的有力形式。当历史由承载着鲜活记忆的人讲述时，年轻人更可能记住它，并把它传承下去。当举国哀悼刘欢这样一位老师与导师的离去，良好指引的价值显得尤为真切。
reading.sourceNote: 基于 ChinaDaily 报道《Buckwheat noodles carry living Long March memories》（吴起县老兵为北京大学生讲述长征历史）改写，并结合《Nation mourns death of singer, mentor Liu Huan》一文中的“导师”主题，围绕“教育与成长”进行整合创作。
